description: This file implements a syntax highlighter plugin for a rich text editor, utilizing ProseMirror and Refractor for code syntax highlighting, including language loading and decoration management.

classes.name: HighlighterState
classes.description: Type representing the plugin's internal state, including decorations and loaded languages.

methods.name: parseNodes
methods.description: Recursively parses Refractor-highlighted nodes into text and class mappings for decoration.

methods.name: getHighlightNodes
methods.description: Extracts child nodes from a Refractor highlight result.

methods.name: getDecorations
methods.description: Generates inline decorations for highlighted code blocks based on language and content.

methods.name: HighlighterPlugin
methods.description: Creates a ProseMirror plugin for syntax highlighting, managing language loading and decorations.

methods.name: updateSelection
methods.description: Updates the node markup to reflect current selection and caret position within code blocks.

methods.name: diffDecorations
methods.description: Computes differences between old and new decorations for efficient updates.
